title: Popeye the Sailor
identity_notes: Frozen GRH snapshot contains twelve files but only six unique recordings: four genuine 1930s radio programs plus two later kiddie/commercial record items. Every title appears twice as an alternate transfer/encode.

classifications.value: NBC Red, WABC, CBS across successive eras
mixed OTR and nonbroadcast record contamination

eras.label: NBC Red / Wheatena run
eras.notes: Thrice-weekly 15-minute radio run; Detmar Poppen as Popeye.

eras.label: WABC / Wheatena run
eras.notes: Monday-Wednesday-Friday 15-minute run; Floyd Buckley as Popeye, Miriam Wolfe as Olive Oyl/Sea Hag.

historical_context.title: Popeye debuts in Thimble Theatre
historical_context.description: Popeye first appeared in E. C. Segar’s King Features comic strip Thimble Theatre.

historical_context.title: Sparse survival and mixed-corpus contamination
historical_context.description: Only a small portion of the historical radio output survives; modern circulation also mixes genuine airchecks with later kiddie records.

historical_context.title: Wheatena sponsorship changes Popeye food references
historical_context.description: Wheatena sponsorship replaced the familiar spinach emphasis with Wheatena promotion in the first two radio runs.

historical_context.title: 1935-1938 Popeye radio adaptations
historical_context.description: Popeye was adapted into several 15-minute radio series across NBC Red, WABC and CBS.
